lens: Deals keep closing into a calmer tape (VIX back to ~18, Dow +1.1%): Berkshire's $8.5B take-private of Taylor Morrison closes, CRH's $150/share bid for Arcosa hits the proxy, and AIP closes its $1.27B Avanos buy — while a contested Genco/Diana tender fight and a wave of strategic reviews (Pitney Bowes, Alithya, KREF) give reps live reasons to call.

stories.headline: Goldman and Moelis advise Taylor Morrison as Berkshire Hathaway closes its $8.5B take-private
stories.why_it_matters: Berkshire Hathaway completed its acquisition of homebuilder Taylor Morrison (TMHC) at $72.50/share cash (~$6.8B equity, ~$8.5B enterprise value). Taylor Morrison's newsroom names Goldman Sachs and Moelis as its financial advisers (sell-side). A closed large-cap take-private caps a diligence cycle spanning confirmatory review, financing, and regulatory workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Use the closed Taylor Morrison deal as a post-close hook with Goldman's (and Moelis's) real-estate/homebuilding coverage — integration and financing workstreams keep secure rooms active past signing.

deal_clock.event: Berkshire Hathaway completes Taylor Morrison acquisition (~$8.5B EV)

stories.headline: Evercore and Goldman advise Arcosa's board as CRH's $150/share, ~$5.4B take-private hits the proxy
stories.why_it_matters: Arcosa (ACA) filed a preliminary proxy (PREM14A) on Jul 24 for its all-cash sale to CRH Americas at $150.00/share. The filing shows Evercore and Goldman Sachs BOTH advising the Arcosa board, each delivering a fairness opinion (Annex B / Annex C). A large-cap industrial take-private with two advisers runs a document-heavy diligence process toward the shareholder vote.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Evercore's (and Goldman's) industrials coverage on Arcosa/CRH — a dual-adviser take-private advancing to a vote runs concentrated confirmatory diligence a data room is built for.

deal_clock.event: Arcosa signs $150.00/share merger with CRH Americas
Arcosa files PREM14A (preliminary proxy)

stories.headline: JPMorgan and UBS advise Avanos Medical as American Industrial Partners closes its $1.27B take-private
stories.why_it_matters: American Industrial Partners completed its acquisition of Avanos Medical (AVNS) at $25.00/share cash (~$1.272B). Avanos's investor room names JPMorgan as lead financial adviser and UBS as financial adviser (both sell-side). A closed medtech sponsor take-private runs concentrated regulatory (FDA/quality) and IP diligence.
stories.suggested_action: Reach out to JPMorgan's (and UBS's) healthcare coverage on the closed Avanos deal — a sponsor medtech take-private is a clean post-close integration and diligence conversation.

deal_clock.event: AIP completes Avanos Medical acquisition (~$1.27B)

stories.headline: Jefferies advises Genco with Morgan Stanley as it rejects Diana Shipping's $24.80 hostile tender
stories.why_it_matters: Genco Shipping & Trading (GNK) filed an SC 14D9 exhibit (Jul 23) responding to Diana Shipping's revised proposal ($24.80 cash + 1 Diana share) and recommending shareholders NOT tender into Diana's separate $24.80/share hostile offer. The filing names Jefferies as financial adviser and Morgan Stanley as special adviser to the Genco board (target defense). One of the few live contested situations — defense mandates move fast.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Jefferies (and Morgan Stanley) on the Genco defense — contested tender fights lean on secure data rooms and rapid adviser collaboration as the board response develops.

deal_clock.event: Genco files SC 14D9; board recommends against Diana's tender

stories.headline: Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo advise Greenbacker on its ~$350M sale to MN8 Energy
stories.why_it_matters: MN8 Energy agreed to acquire Greenbacker Renewable Energy ($350M at closing plus up to $25M contingent, ~$1.71/share), creating a top-3 US clean-power platform (~6.2 GW). An investor-call transcript (Form 425, Jul 27) confirms Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo advised Greenbacker (seller), with Wells Fargo delivering the fairness opinion. The deal ran a 60+ party auction and now advances to an S-4.
stories.suggested_action: Open with Morgan Stanley's (and Wells Fargo's) power/renewables coverage on Greenbacker/MN8 — a multi-bidder auction consolidating into an S-4 process is a strong secure sell-side diligence use case.

deal_clock.event: MN8 agrees to acquire Greenbacker (~$350M + earnout)
Investor-call transcript filed (Form 425)

stories.headline: Morgan Stanley advises Leonardo DRS on its $450M acquisition of AI software firm Raft; JPMorgan advises Raft
stories.why_it_matters: Leonardo DRS (DRS) agreed to acquire Raft, a multi-domain AI, data-fusion and mission-software firm, for $450M cash. The release names Morgan Stanley as adviser to Leonardo DRS (buyer) and JPMorgan as exclusive adviser to Raft (seller). A defense-AI carve-in runs CFIUS-type regulatory and classified-adjacent IP diligence into a Q4-2026 close.
stories.suggested_action: Reach out to Morgan Stanley's (and JPMorgan's) defense/tech coverage on Leonardo DRS/Raft — defense-software deals run heavy regulatory and IP diligence a secure room is built for.

deal_clock.event: Leonardo DRS agrees to acquire Raft for $450M

stories.headline: Moelis advises USA Rare Earth on its cross-border merger with SVRE Holdings
stories.why_it_matters: USA Rare Earth (USAR) filed a definitive proxy (DEFM14A, Jul 24) for its merger with SVRE Holdings (BVI; Brazil/Switzerland operations), with SVRE holders taking ~34.1% of the combined company. The filing names Moelis as financial adviser to the USAR board (fairness opinion dated Apr 19). A critical-minerals deal with a US-government offtake angle runs heavy cross-border regulatory and technical diligence.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Moelis's coverage on USA Rare Earth/SVRE — a multi-jurisdiction critical-minerals merger heading to a vote is an ideal structured-data-room diligence process.

deal_clock.event: USA Rare Earth files DEFM14A; special meeting called

stories.source: SEC EDGAR — USA Rare Earth DEFM14A

stories.headline: JPMorgan and Barclays are dealer managers on PG&E utility's upsized $1.2B cash tender offers

stories.suggested_action: Note JPMorgan and Barclays as dealer managers on the PG&E tender — liability-management mandates keep DCM teams in structured document workflows worth a light-touch outreach.

stories.headline: Stifel's KBW advises First Seacoast Bancorp on its $17.25/share sale to Cambridge Financial Group

stories.headline: Calmer tape: Dow +1.1%, VIX eases to ~18, 10Y slips to 4.59% as WTI drops ~4%
stories.why_it_matters: US equities were mixed-to-firm on Jul 28 — Dow +1.1% (52,804), S&P +0.3% (7,433), Nasdaq roughly flat (-0.1%), Russell 2000 flat — with the VIX easing ~4% to ~18 and the 10Y yield slipping to ~4.59%.
